brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
DR Congo, Sudan and Mali are Africa’s biggest military drone importers as US and Iran supply rival sides in Russia-Ukraine war. [1]
People are making perilous journeys to escape violence in DRC. [2]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR DR CONGO
The Do Not Travel advisory for Congo - Kinshasa reflects the severe security risks that drive people to flee violence. [2][E1]
Congo - Kinshasa's military drone imports from rival suppliers may increase its exposure to US and Iran sanctions, given its 85 OFAC and SEMA designations. [1][E2]

KEY RISKS
Congo - Kinshasa's 85 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations pose a risk of further financial restrictions. [E2]

WATCH ITEMS
The outbreak of Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus in Democratic Republic of the Congo remains unresolved. [4]
